meanings.en: very small in amount or not enough
meanings.exampleEn: They survived on a meagre diet of bread and water.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekmek ve sudan oluşan yetersiz bir beslenmeyle hayatta kaldılar.

meanings.en: showing that you think someone or something is ridiculous or worthless
meanings.exampleEn: He gave a derisive laugh when he heard the excuse.
meanings.exampleTr: Bahaneyi duyunca alaycı bir kahkaha attı.

meanings.en: to make a long, high sound
meanings.exampleEn: The children squealed with delight when they saw the puppy.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar köpek yavrusunu görünce sevinçle ciyakladı.

meanings.en: a long, high sound or cry
meanings.exampleEn: There was a loud squeal of tyres as the car braked.
meanings.exampleTr: Araba fren yapınca lastiklerin tiz bir gıcırtısı duyuldu.

meanings.en: a short fight or struggle, especially in order to get something
meanings.exampleEn: There was a brief tussle over the ball near the goal.
meanings.exampleTr: Kale önünde top için kısa bir boğuşma yaşandı.

meanings.en: to fight or struggle with someone, often for something
meanings.exampleEn: The two boys tussled over the last piece of cake.
meanings.exampleTr: İki çocuk son parça kek için itişip kakıştı.

meanings.en: a short fight between small groups, often part of a larger conflict
meanings.exampleEn: There was a brief skirmish between the two armies at the border.
meanings.exampleTr: İki ordu arasında sınırda kısa bir çatışma oldu.

meanings.en: a short argument or disagreement
meanings.exampleEn: The debate turned into a verbal skirmish between the candidates.
meanings.exampleTr: Tartışma adaylar arasında sözlü bir atışmaya döndü.

meanings.en: the act of making a person or animal calm, especially with drugs
meanings.exampleEn: The tranquillization of the wild animal allowed the vets to examine it safely.
meanings.exampleTr: Vahşi hayvanın sakinleştirilmesi veterinerlerin onu güvenle muayene etmesini sağladı.

meanings.tr: masa başına bağlı, büro işi olan
meanings.en: spending most of your working time sitting at a desk rather than being active
meanings.exampleEn: After years of a desk-bound job, he decided to work outdoors.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıllarca masa başı bir işte çalıştıktan sonra açık havada çalışmaya karar verdi.

meanings.en: thinking only about yourself and considering your own interests most important
meanings.exampleEn: His egocentric attitude made it hard for him to work in a team.
meanings.exampleTr: Benmerkezci tutumu takım içinde çalışmasını zorlaştırdı.

meanings.en: the act of giving up your own interests or wishes to help others
meanings.exampleEn: Her success was built on years of self-sacrifice for her family.
meanings.exampleTr: Başarısı, ailesi için yıllarca yaptığı fedakârlık üzerine kuruluydu.

meanings.en: the practice of avoiding physical pleasures and living a simple life, often for religious reasons
meanings.exampleEn: The monk's asceticism meant he owned almost nothing.
meanings.exampleTr: Keşişin çileciliği neredeyse hiçbir şeye sahip olmaması anlamına geliyordu.

meanings.en: the act of allowing yourself to have or do things you enjoy, often too much
meanings.exampleEn: A whole day at the spa felt like pure self-indulgence.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaplıcada geçen koca bir gün tam bir kendini şımartma gibiydi.

meanings.en: the value or respect you have for yourself
meanings.exampleEn: Losing his job badly damaged his sense of self-worth.
meanings.exampleTr: İşini kaybetmesi öz değer duygusuna ağır zarar verdi.

meanings.en: believing that pleasure is the most important thing in life
meanings.exampleEn: They led a hedonistic lifestyle full of parties and travel.
meanings.exampleTr: Partiler ve seyahatlerle dolu hazcı bir yaşam sürdüler.

meanings.en: willing to give up things you want or enjoy for the sake of others or a goal
meanings.exampleEn: She was self-denying, always putting her children's needs first.
meanings.exampleTr: Kendini feda eden biriydi, her zaman çocuklarının ihtiyaçlarını öne koyardı.

meanings.en: a strong feeling of dislike or hatred for yourself
meanings.exampleEn: His constant failures filled him with self-hatred.
meanings.exampleTr: Sürekli yaşadığı başarısızlıklar onu kendinden nefretle doldurdu.

meanings.en: a strong feeling of dislike or shame about yourself and your behaviour
meanings.exampleEn: He was overcome with self-disgust after breaking his promise.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözünü bozduktan sonra kendinden tiksinme duygusuna kapıldı.

meanings.en: care and respect for yourself and your own happiness
meanings.exampleEn: The book teaches readers the importance of self-love and acceptance.
meanings.exampleTr: Kitap okuyuculara kendini sevmenin ve kabul etmenin önemini öğretiyor.

meanings.en: able to control your emotions and behaviour even in difficult situations
meanings.exampleEn: She stayed calm and self-controlled throughout the argument.
meanings.exampleTr: Tartışma boyunca sakin ve kendine hakim kaldı.

meanings.en: able to do or decide things by yourself without needing help from others
meanings.exampleEn: Living alone made her more self-reliant.
meanings.exampleTr: Yalnız yaşamak onu daha kendine yeter biri yaptı.

meanings.en: the state of being lower in rank, position or age than others
meanings.exampleEn: Because of his juniority, he was not invited to the board meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Kıdemsizliği nedeniyle yönetim kurulu toplantısına çağrılmadı.

meanings.en: the quality of reacting quickly and positively to something
meanings.exampleEn: Customers praised the company's responsiveness to their complaints.
meanings.exampleTr: Müşteriler şirketin şikayetlerine gösterdiği duyarlılığı övdü.

meanings.en: a lack of understanding or care about other people's feelings
meanings.exampleEn: His insensitivity to her grief made things worse.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun kederine gösterdiği duyarsızlık işleri daha da kötüleştirdi.

meanings.en: a thing that separates one area or part from another
meanings.exampleEn: A glass divider separated the two offices.
meanings.exampleTr: Cam bir bölme iki ofisi ayırıyordu.

meanings.en: the quality of being serious and sincere
meanings.exampleEn: She spoke with great earnestness about the need for change.
meanings.exampleTr: Değişim ihtiyacı hakkında büyük bir ciddiyetle konuştu.

meanings.en: the way in which the parts of something are arranged or set up
meanings.exampleEn: You can change the configuration of the software in the settings menu.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazılımın yapılandırmasını ayarlar menüsünden değiştirebilirsiniz.

meanings.en: the particular arrangement of the parts of something
meanings.exampleEn: The configuration of the furniture made the room feel larger.
meanings.exampleTr: Mobilyaların düzeni odayı daha geniş hissettiriyordu.

meanings.en: the quality of being felt or done very strongly
meanings.exampleEn: The intensity of the storm surprised everyone.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtınanın şiddeti herkesi şaşırttı.

meanings.en: the strength of something such as light, sound or heat
meanings.exampleEn: You can adjust the intensity of the light with this dial.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu düğmeyle ışığın yoğunluğunu ayarlayabilirsiniz.

meanings.en: not certain and slightly suspicious about something
meanings.exampleEn: I was dubious about the plan from the start.
meanings.exampleTr: Baştan beri plan konusunda kuşkuluydum.

meanings.en: probably not honest, safe or good
meanings.exampleEn: The company has a dubious reputation for reliability.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirketin güvenilirlik konusunda şüpheli bir ünü var.

meanings.en: seeming dishonest or not able to be trusted (informal, British)
meanings.exampleEn: He made his money through some dodgy business deals.
meanings.exampleTr: Parasını bazı şüpheli iş anlaşmalarıyla kazandı.

meanings.en: not in good condition or likely to cause problems (informal)
meanings.exampleEn: My knee has been a bit dodgy since the accident.
meanings.exampleTr: Kazadan beri dizim biraz sorunlu.

meanings.en: not feeling embarrassed or guilty about something, even if others might
meanings.exampleEn: She is an unashamed fan of cheesy pop music.
meanings.exampleTr: Basit pop müziğinin utanmadan hayranı olduğunu söyler.

meanings.en: a quantity of goods that is sent or delivered somewhere
meanings.exampleEn: A large consignment of coffee arrived at the port this morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu sabah limana büyük bir kahve sevkiyatı geldi.

meanings.en: a lack of care, effort or neatness in doing something
meanings.exampleEn: The report was full of errors caused by sheer sloppiness.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor tamamen özensizlikten kaynaklanan hatalarla doluydu.

meanings.en: unable to see or plan sensibly for the future; short-sighted in thinking
meanings.exampleEn: Their myopic focus on short-term profit hurt the company later.
meanings.exampleTr: Kısa vadeli kâra odaklı dar görüşlülükleri şirkete sonradan zarar verdi.

meanings.en: not able to see distant things clearly
meanings.exampleEn: He is so myopic that he cannot read road signs without glasses.
meanings.exampleTr: O kadar miyop ki gözlüksüz yol tabelalarını okuyamıyor.

meanings.en: able to understand situations quickly and use this to your advantage
meanings.exampleEn: She is an astute investor who rarely loses money.
meanings.exampleTr: Nadiren para kaybeden, işini bilen zeki bir yatırımcıdır.

meanings.en: clever and able to think quickly, especially about money or business
meanings.exampleEn: A canny buyer always compares prices before deciding.
meanings.exampleTr: Açıkgöz bir alıcı karar vermeden önce her zaman fiyatları karşılaştırır.

meanings.en: in a way that shows a clever understanding of a situation
meanings.exampleEn: He astutely predicted the collapse of the market.
meanings.exampleTr: Piyasanın çöküşünü zekice tahmin etti.

meanings.en: in a clever and careful way, especially in order to gain an advantage
meanings.exampleEn: She cannily invested her savings before prices rose.
meanings.exampleTr: Fiyatlar yükselmeden önce birikimlerini kurnazca yatırdı.

meanings.en: the ability to understand situations quickly and act to your advantage
meanings.exampleEn: Her business astuteness helped the firm survive the crisis.
meanings.exampleTr: İş konusundaki keskin zekası firmanın krizi atlatmasına yardımcı oldu.

meanings.tr: sezgi gücü, keskin zeka, isabetli karar yeteneği
meanings.en: the ability to make good judgments and quick decisions, especially in business
meanings.exampleEn: His business acumen turned a small shop into a national chain.
meanings.exampleTr: İş konusundaki keskin zekası küçük bir dükkânı ulusal bir zincire dönüştürdü.

meanings.en: to refuse to accept something or someone, especially in a proud or unkind way
meanings.exampleEn: She spurned all his offers of help.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun tüm yardım tekliflerini geri çevirdi.

meanings.en: to deliberately exclude someone from a group or society
meanings.exampleEn: After the scandal, he was ostracized by his colleagues.
meanings.exampleTr: Skandaldan sonra meslektaşları tarafından dışlandı.

meanings.en: the act of deliberately excluding someone from a group or society
meanings.exampleEn: He faced social ostracism after speaking out against the leaders.
meanings.exampleTr: Liderlere karşı konuştuktan sonra toplumsal dışlanmayla karşılaştı.

meanings.en: the act of surrounding a place, group or person on all sides
meanings.exampleEn: The army's encirclement of the city cut off all supplies.
meanings.exampleTr: Ordunun şehri kuşatması tüm ikmali kesti.

meanings.en: the act of officially joining a course, school or organization
meanings.exampleEn: Enrollment for the new semester begins next Monday.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni dönem için kayıtlar önümüzdeki Pazartesi başlıyor.

meanings.en: the number of people who have officially joined something
meanings.exampleEn: The university reported a record enrollment this year.
meanings.exampleTr: Üniversite bu yıl rekor bir öğrenci kaydı bildirdi.

meanings.en: an arrangement to receive a product or service regularly by paying in advance
meanings.exampleEn: I cancelled my magazine subscription last month.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçen ay dergi aboneliğimi iptal ettim.

meanings.en: an amount of money you pay regularly to receive a service or be a member
meanings.exampleEn: The annual subscription costs fifty pounds.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıllık abonelik ücreti elli sterlin.

meanings.en: the act of ending a subscription to a service, list or publication
meanings.exampleEn: The email included a simple unsubscription link at the bottom.
meanings.exampleTr: E-postanın altında basit bir abonelik iptali bağlantısı vardı.
